# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003), [v2 c5 P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy / Student  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, gloomy face. He features black eyes and a sullen exterior.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Initially sullen, dark, and hostile, Anthony exhibits defiance towards authority and shows disdain for school discipline. He belongs to the Tulk family, who are known for breaking established rules and conventions. Despite his rough demeanor, he responds to physical correction and respects strength, showing a softer side by smirking and offering assistance once won over.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c12 P54](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0054)_

## History

Anthony attended the Brierley School in the class taught by Nell Harcourt. On the first day of the school term, he sat alone in a corner desk and glared at his new teacher with open enmity. During recess on his first day, he emptied water from his slate bottle down the back of Aurelia Clay's neck, after which Nell kept him inside to lecture him on how gentlemen should behave toward ladies, though he left unaffected with a contemptuous whistle. Months later, during winter, his behavior led Nell to snap and strike him across his hand with a hardwood pointer until tears filled his eyes. Rather than harboring a permanent grudge, Anthony's respect was won by the beating; he subsequently tipped his cap to Nell, carried her school books through deep snow, and remarked that her thrashing was as good as a man's.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
